name: agentic-id
description: Resolve B2B people and companies to one stable ID from a verified identity ledger, then validate, enrich, find, discover and find look-alikes, with every value marked verified, corroborated or claimed. Connects to the hosted Agentic ID server (sign in with your iCustomer account from /mcp); credit-aware skills and a lead-qualification agent. Runs nothing on your computer.
